description.narrative: Supporting the Government to rapidly mitigate the impact of COVID- 19 through high level policy support, assess the impact of COVID 19 on MSMEs and provide recommendations to the government, and support MSMEs to recalibrate their business

sector.narrative: Structural transformation, including green, inclusive and digital transitions

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
UNDP as the Implementing Partner will comply with the policies, procedures and practices of the United Nations Security Management System (UNSMS.)

description.narrative: - Form an inclusive “plan ahead team” to develop a strategic action plan to support the Government of Egypt (GoE) in identifying the required policies, measures and actions on COVID-19 response - Conduct a national survey to assess the needs of MSMEs affected by the COVID-19 - Conduct an in-depth study on the impact of the COVID-19 outbreak on the Egyptian private sector - Develop the digital platform and training and capacity building packages to support digital transformation for MSMEs - Support MSMEs to recalibrate their business on mask production (at least 156,000 surgical masks per month).

comment.narrative: - No inclusive “plan ahead team” exists. - No national survey on COVID-19 impacts on MSMEs and private sector conducted - Digital platform in MSMEDA is under development - No MSMEs supported

- Form an inclusive “plan ahead team” to develop a strategic action plan to support the GoE in identifying the required policies, measures and actions to accelerate the decision making for steepening the economic curve on the medium short/term - Conduct a national gender sensitive survey to assess the needs of MSMEs affected by the COVID -19 in order to propose comprehensive policies and measures aimed at improving their economic situation - Conduct an in-depth gender sensitive study on the impact of the COVID-19 outbreak on the Egyptian private sector with focus on macroeconomics, key sectors and large companies - Provide transformation and their continuous need for capacity building, mentoring and coaching paying attention to the generational and gender digital gap, to priority enterprises among 250,000 MSMEs. - Support at least 2 MSMEs to recalibrate their business: In order to address the dramatic and sudden loss of demand and revenue and make use of the opportunity of the increasing demand on face masks and gowns (at least 156,000 surgical masks per month).
- Project were not initiated due to the security clearance of the Government of Egypt

- Form an inclusive “plan ahead team” to develop a strategic action plan to support the GoE in identifying the required policies, measures and actions to accelerate the decision making for steepening the economic curve on the medium short/term - Conduct a national gender sensitive survey to assess the needs of MSMEs affected by the COVID -19 in order to propose comprehensive policies and measures aimed at improving their economic situation - Conduct an in-depth gender sensitive study on the impact of the COVID-19 outbreak on the Egyptian private sector with focus on macroeconomics, key sectors and large companies - Provide transformation and their continuous need for capacity building, mentoring and coaching paying attention to the generational and gender digital gap, to priority enterprises among 250,000 MSMEs. - Support at least 2 MSMEs to recalibrate their business: In order to address the dramatic and sudden loss of demand and revenue and make use of the opportunity of the increasing demand on face masks and gowns (at least 156,000 surgical masks per month).

3.1 A -Two international webinars on the future of key development issues post COVID-19 were held, one focused on the “Future of Policy Making in the Era of Big Data”, and the other focused on the “Future of Digital Skills with a focus on Technical Education”. -Two policy papers and associated policy briefs were developed based on the topics of the webinars, and using key discussions and presentations as inputs. -Final draft of the study of Impact of COVID and the stimulus package on the Egyptian economy submitted to MoPED for review -Design and development of the Egypt Development Portal for tracking SDG progress in Egypt initiated. -Training on the use of International Futures tool for simulating different scenarios of the future of SDGs post COVID commenced. -Study of the impact of COVID on employment on the local level developed -Data Management training held for Egypt Post in order to promote Financial Inclusion
3.1 B - Phone and field surveys completed - Analysis and policy recommendations reports completed and accepted by MoPED. Launching event conducted in June 2021 and the expert consultation workshop as held in September 27th - The final report to be completed by 15th of October
- 3.1 C: Report on the impact of COVID on the private sector in partnership with EBRD and AmCham is finalized and will be launched in Q1 of 2022.
- 3.2 A: the private cloud infrastructure developed
- 3.2 B ENID Ready Made Garments (RMG) factory in El Manna village in Qena is now equipped and operational for the production of masks.
